summary: Acquittal appeal by State rejected for lack of leave; private party appeal permitted; hostile witnesses (son, watchman, panch, lodge manager); unreliable last seen evidence; non-recovery of key forensic reports (fingerprint, dog squad); delayed and inconsistent testimonies; failure to prove last seen, disclosure, or recovery; no proof of accused's presence at crime scene; absence of tamper-proof chain for recovered blood-stained clothes; abscondence not conclusive of guilt; prosecution failed to discharge burden under Cr.P.C. s.378(3); leave rightly denied by High Court.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order upholding acquittal upheld.
